name: aeko-plugin
description: AEKO skills for Codex — first-run onboarding plus AEO workflows for ecommerce visibility, product pages, content, schema, and action items. User-facing steps mirror the user's language. Pair with the AEKO MCP connector for backend tool access.

interface.shortDescription: AEO skills for ecommerce — onboarding, visibility, PDP, content, schema
interface.longDescription: AEKO skills guide Codex through AEO (AI Engine Optimization) workflows for cross-border ecommerce. After install, run /aeko-onboarding to confirm setup, tour the skills, and choose the right next step. User-facing steps mirror the user's language while stable commands, file paths, slugs, and schema keys stay in English/ASCII. Then measure AI visibility, improve product pages for ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity citations, draft citation-ready content, manage your brand kit, and execute action items. Requires the AEKO MCP connector for backend access.
defaultPrompt: Run /aeko-onboarding and show me where to start.
Show me my AEKO action items.
Create an AI visibility report for my domain.
